decision.explanation: Both 'University of Nottingham' and 'Technical University of Darmstadt' are explicitly stated in the original sources as institutions attended by Willy Schwabacher. Document d1 (D1S2) states he attended the University of Nottingham during his undergraduate years, while document d2 (D2S4 and D2S9) confirms he enrolled at the Technical University of Darmstadt in the early 20th century. These are distinct educational phases and institutions, and both are directly supported by the source texts. There is no evidence to exclude either claim, nor any indication that these refer to the same institution under different names.
